requirement.description: Testbench processes are not properly receiving the context parameter when invoked, causing TypeError when testbench functions expect a 'ctx' argument.
requirement.contract: When a testbench process is added via add_testbench(), the process function should be invoked with a context parameter that provides access to simulation state (signals, domains, etc.). The context should support methods like ctx.get(), ctx.set(), and ctx.tick().

requirement.description: Domain lookup functionality is comparing different ClockDomain instances instead of checking equality properly, causing assertion failures.
requirement.contract: The domain lookup mechanism should correctly compare ClockDomain objects by their properties rather than identity, ensuring that equivalent domains are recognized as the same.
